scope: Saved sampled per-process RSS/resident/footprint maxima, never OS peaks or additive physical totals. Saved operator gauges are keyed by all attributes and start/timestamp; exports are deduplicated, conflicts and counter/high-water resets remain unqualified. No per-PID operator attribution, complete metric coverage, native allocation, PSS, OS32 envelope or Flight byte qualification. Raw metric timestamp strings retain the original client's rendering, without inferred timezone.
